description: This source file contains the PHP class 'SubscriptionPlan' which is part of the Opencart admin model for catalog subscription plans. It provides methods to add, edit, delete, copy, and retrieve subscription plans and their descriptions, interfacing with the database for CRUD operations.

classes.name: SubscriptionPlan
classes.description: Manages CRUD operations for subscription plans within the OpenCart admin catalog module, including handling descriptions in multiple languages.

methods.name: addSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Inserts a new subscription plan into the database and adds its descriptions for different languages.

methods.name: editSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Updates an existing subscription plan and replaces its descriptions.

methods.name: copySubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Creates a copy of an existing subscription plan with its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Deletes a subscription plan and its descriptions, and removes related subscriptions from products.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Retrieves a specific subscription plan and its description in the current language.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscription plans, optionally filtered by name and with pagination and sorting.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Returns the total count of subscription plans in the database.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Gets all descriptions for a subscription plan across all languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions for all subscription plans in a specific language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a subscription plan in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a subscription plan.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions in a specific language across all plans.
